relations: The central flame contacts the evergreen branches, so the fire spreads outward through the pile.
Burning branches lose structure and collapse inward into the brick pit as they char.
Rising heat draws smoke upward from the flame into the dusk sky.
The brick ring confines the burning pile, keeping embers within the pit.
